technique_name: Outline a specific strategy to prevent cyberbullying online.
description: A comprehensive strategy to prevent cyberbullying online must begin with education. Schools, parents, and community organizations should provide children and young people with the skills to recognize when they or their peers are being cyberbullied and to respond safely. Additionally, children and young people should be taught how to responsibly use the internet and its various platforms, such as social media, so that they understand how their words and actions online can have consequences.
